reason: Joining the upper arm and forearm bones seems like a practical first step toward the bending framework.
expectation: I expect a basic elbow framework, though it may still need cartilage and other parts to move smoothly.

alternatives.reason: Cartilage and joint fluid seem useful for smooth movement, but I want to assemble the bones first.

effect: The bones provide rigid supports, so the next step is to prepare the joint surfaces.
reaction: The distinction between bending bones and movement at a joint is clear.
reason: Cartilage and joint fluid are the only offered combination and seem relevant to smooth joint movement.
expectation: I expect them to form a smooth joint surface or cushioning, though I don't know exactly how the game will represent it.

effect: The result explains how cartilage and fluid reduce grinding, and the new goal points toward assembling the joint.
reaction: The description makes the purpose of the smooth surfaces clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should join the prepared surfaces to the bones.
expectation: I expect an elbow framework with smooth joint surfaces; it may still need ligaments for stability.

effect: The joint now permits the forearm to turn, but it still needs stabilization and a source of pulling force.
reaction: The distinction between allowing movement and producing it is useful.
reason: Ligaments are the only offered combination and should help stabilize the articulated bones.
expectation: I expect a more stable elbow framework, though it will still need something to pull it into motion.

effect: Ligaments complete the stable framework, and the empty front and rear pull slots show where opposing muscles would fit later.
reaction: The bone-to-bone connection is clear, though ending just before adding the muscles leaves me curious.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the smooth surfaces to the bones was most worthwhile because it clarified that a joint allows movement but does not supply the force.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the bones was straightforward and offered little choice beyond establishing the framework.

surprise.text: The distinction between a movable joint and a source of pulling force sharpened my understanding of the construction.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each part had a clear role in building or stabilizing the joint.

continue.text: I would continue to see how opposing muscles attach and produce the pull, since this chapter leaves that question open.
